snippet.description:
Radius of Curvature for Pedal Curves & Tangential Polar Equations in Differential Calculus. Learn complete formula derivation, pedal equation solved problems, and B.Sc Maths exam concepts step-by-step.

Namaste Learners! 🙏
Welcome back to Fractal Frontier Maths. Is video lecture mein hum cover kar rahe hain "Radius of Curvature for Pedal Curves" (पदिक वक्रों के लिए वक्रता त्रिज्या) aur "Tangential Polar Equations" (p-psi relations).

📌 Topics Covered in this Video:
00:00 - Introduction & Pedal Equations Overview
00:56 - Derivation: Radius of Curvature for Pedal Curves (ρ = r dr/dp)
06:50 - Example 1: Radius of Curvature for an Ellipse (1/p² = 1/a² + 1/b² - r²/a²b²)
09:30 - Example 2: Radius of Curvature for Lemniscate (r³ = a²p)
11:30 - Important Proof: Curvature using transformation u = 1/r
19:28 - Tangential Polar Equations (p-ψ Form) Formula Derivation (ρ = p + d²p/dψ²)
23:45 - Example 3: Finding ρ for p = b sinψ cosψ
27:03 - Example 4: Finding ρ for p² = a² cos²ψ + b² sin²ψ
37:40 - Summary & Introduction to Centre of Curvature

🔸B.Tech Engineering Maths

👉 https://amzn.to/4cRttb2

📘 Integral Calculus – Shanti Narayan & P.K. Mittal
👉 https://amzn.to/4cReFsT

📘 Calculus, Vol. 1: One-Variable Calculus, with an Introduction to Linear Algebra – Tom M. Apostol
👉 https://amzn.to/4mBuoQ9

📘Higher Engineering Mathematics — B.S. Grewal
